title: Prospective primary endpoint registry preparation

bootstrap.resampling_unit: paired temporal origin blocks within trajectory; never cross trajectory boundary
bootstrap.sharing: same draw schedule for every matched method, contrast, registered horizon and model seed in the same origin domain
bootstrap.block_length_status: baseline-calibration-pending; freeze per domain from accepted P3A validation dependence rule; reject unsupported lengths, never cap

forecast_metric_contract.per_horizon: pool absolute residual sums/counts over valid cells within each model seed; compute horizon MAE
forecast_metric_contract.composite: equal mean over predeclared required horizons, then equal mean over model seeds 0-4

required_horizons_by_domain.synthetic: freeze exact required offsets from approved synthetic task protocol

forecast_metric_contract.zero_valid_support: unidentifiable; block endpoint and family decision, never silently drop the row

endpoint_templates.contrast: V4 minus V9 under the same noise-only input/seed/origin; lower V4 false graph TV is the predicted direction
endpoint_templates.temporal_slice: all predeclared noise-only steps; exact synthetic strata and onset exclusions frozen before test
endpoint_templates.domain_conditions: all synthetic noise-only strata required by implementation-plan §3 and claim-evidence matrix, including declared missingness levels; no data-driven selection
endpoint_templates.inferential_producer: pending; current paired_statistics_shared_v4 only supports forecast MAE/RMSE

endpoint_templates.contrast: V4 versus V9, with V0/V1 and fixed-periodic graph as required contextual controls; retain structural-change response and do not suppress prediction quality
endpoint_templates.direction: signed response contrast plus one-sided forecast noninferiority; numeric tolerance baseline-calibration-pending
endpoint_templates.temporal_slice: all preregistered identity/weight-change trajectories, with exact switch-relative slices fixed from approved synthetic protocol before test
endpoint_templates.domain_conditions: 10% and 30% dependency changes, identity versus weight changes, and all required missingness strata; no post hoc subset
producer_expected_outputs: switch-relative forecast errors and recovery/delay summary
calibrated epsilon and its validation evidence hash
CI/raw p and complete support counts
endpoint_templates.status: candidate operationalization; exact primary response statistic and slice boundaries require root/P3A selection

endpoint_templates.contrast: informative-c matched-graph retention versus shuffled-c, constant-g, and unconditional neighbor-reset; include V3/V4 and V1/V2 context; compare matched-width arms
endpoint_templates.direction: left-minus-control error/recovery; negative error or shorter predeclared recovery time favors informative-c
endpoint_templates.temporal_slice: switch-relative post-change origin support only; freeze the complete supported post-change slice and recovery definition before test
endpoint_templates.domain_conditions: all declared synthetic identity/weight-change conditions and relevant missingness strata; any real-data strata required by accepted family design must be explicit
producer_expected_outputs: per-origin error curve and recovery statistic
teacher graph/action match proof per step
paired CI/raw p and support counts
endpoint_templates.prescribed_graph_supplement: frozen_h2_matched_retention_v2; teacher V4 graph/action sequence is forced identically across retention arms; graph scorer work is diagnostic overhead and not a speed comparison
endpoint_templates.limitations: ordinary shuffled/constant/reset runs may change later graphs through prediction-residual feedback; only the matched-graph supplement identifies memory-arm specificity

endpoint_templates.contrast: V7 versus full V4 and periodic V5 and random V6; compare adaptive ANN V8 to V7 only as the separately named SNN-value contrast
endpoint_templates.direction: forecast error must remain within validation-calibrated tolerance; lower measured cost favors selective policy
endpoint_templates.temporal_slice: same frozen checkpoint, full required replay windows, same input/targets and policy seed; no subset timing
endpoint_templates.domain_conditions: email and MOOC, CPU and CUDA reported separately; every registered policy/quota/cost-table cell required by accepted independent quota grid
producer_expected_outputs: paired CI/raw p and full coverage
endpoint_templates.status: calibration-pending; measured cost inference requires an accepted paired timing producer; action-count reduction alone is not acceleration

secondary_endpoints_unless_promoted_befo: spike rate, membrane summaries, graph/state ages and detailed trace diagnostics
additional robustness slices beyond the enumerated primary family

family_assembly_rules.missing_or_unidentifiable_endpoint: family decision blocked; endpoint set cannot shrink
family_assembly_rules.oracle: may define preregistered synthetic reporting slices only after all model predictions/source/weight checks; never enters training, graph generation, memory or scheduler

unresolved_before_acceptance: Root must choose and freeze exact synthetic primary strata and exact required synthetic horizons from the approved task protocol; this draft does not prune declared conditions.
Root must define the exact post-change primary slice and recovery functional; do not infer a switch interval or threshold from test outcomes.
H3 accuracy epsilon and block lengths require accepted baseline/validation calibration; no numeric values are proposed here.

The current Holm assembler rejects non-forecast outcome types. A versioned producer/schema is needed for graph-TV, post-change recovery/noninferiority and paired measured cost endpoints, with tests and explicit raw-p pointers.
Root must specify whether real-data strata belong in H1/H2 mechanism families and freeze that multiplicity before test; no cross-domain pooling or compensatory averaging is implied.
Timing uncertainty unit/repeat aggregation and inference method need a validated producer; repeated timings are not independent model seeds.
